newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 10.

text.p: Ruling People's Alliance parliamentarians tell Justice Minister G.L. Peiris to get people's mandate through referendum on government peace plan as opposition United Nation Party has not taken clear stand on issue.
Police search Wilpattu jungles for Tamil Tiger rebel suicide squad.
Sri Lanka emerges as world's best tea producer fetching highest price for its tea. Prices of rubber, coconut and cinnamon also rise.
Japanese loans help to avert crisis in railways which were on verge of grinding to a halt.
Police find Tamil Tiger rebel safe house in Ratmalana suburb of Colombo.
Referendum to decide permenant merger of northern and eastern provinces to be held by October 13.
Police probe Tamil Tiger rebel intelligence unit operating in Colombo.
